settings.itemStepFirDesc: Line up at the entrance, scan the QR code, enter your email address, and receive your game pass;
settings.itemStepSecondDesc: Form a team of 5 players and enter; follow the NPC’s instructions to enter Room 1;
settings.itemStepThirdDesc: In the repair bay, all 5 players must work together to install the “light module,” then escape the escape room;
settings.itemStepNoteDesc:
1. Players with claustrophobia should proceed with caution.

2. This attraction features flashing lights. If you have any sensitivity to flashing lights, please inform our staff before entering. If you feel unwell at any time during the attraction, please notify a staff member immediately.
